name: A F Enterprises Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1983, AF Enterprises Ltd is in the business of manufacturing & trading of plastic and related products. It also trades 
in fabrics, emerald, glasses, etc.[1]
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1][2]
The company offers a wide range of plastic products, including containers, RO water purifiers, safety helmets, crates, standees, DB box parts, COVID eye goggles, PPE kits, washing machine panels, plastic toys, irrigation sprinklers, dustbins, coolers, automobile components, industrial bins, milk crates, wire spools, packaging materials, bottle caps, electrical parts, combs, chairs, tables, mechanical parts, musical instrument components, and storage containers.
It also provides a variety of plastic crates in different sizes, variants, and colors, catering to sectors like pharma, fisheries, dairy, automotive, textiles, and horticulture.
